title: Chief Actuary
description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions-from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.
As a Chief Actuary, you will:

• Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.

• Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.

• Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

• Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.

• Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.

• Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.

• Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.

• Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.

• Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.

• Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.

• Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.

• Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:
First 90 Days

• Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.

• Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.

• Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.

• Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

• Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial w

title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate Sponsor-dedicated
description:
Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate Sponsor-dedicated
Job Location: Athens, Greece
Job Location Type: Home-based
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.
Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.
• Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
• Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
• Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
• Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.
Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.
• Requires at least 2 years of year of on-site monitoring experience.
• Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements.
• i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of Greek and English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Effective time and financial management skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. Introducing the Trainline Tax Team 👋

Trainline is a FTSE 250 global travel tech business, and our Tax team plays a central role in how we manage our financial responsibilities across the Group. Since our Group Head of Tax joined, we have been on an exciting journey - building out a dynamic in-house tax function and transitioning from a fully outsourced model to a proactive, value-adding internal advisory and compliance capability. - Drive the budgeting and forecasting of corporation taxes, leveraging forecasting software (Pigment) and automating calculations where possible, whilst managing Quarterly Instalment Payments and cash tax positions in collaboration with the Finance and Treasury teams.

- Review and manage UK and EU VAT return submissions via Making Tax Digital software, and oversee Operational Transfer Pricing across Group entities, ensuring intercompany agreements are maintained and invoicing is operating as expected.

- Champion tax process improvement across the business, identifying automation opportunities, communicating best practices, and delivering training to the wider team to embed lasting change.

- Manage tax governance for the Group, including the CCO risk register, the SAO annual process, tax accounting controls, and process documentation, ensuring a well-governed and audit-ready function.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Beacon Funding is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to test existing and new applications across our technology ecosystem, spanning internal systems (origination, underwriting, servicing, and portfolio management) and customer- and dealer-facing portals. This role combines manual and automated testing to identify and isolate defects across both legacy and current platforms, and works as an embedded member of an Agile Scrum team to ensure quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than caught at the end of it. We're looking for someone who actively applies AI-assisted testing technologies - for test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent defect analysis - to increase coverage and reduce the manual maintenance burden on the automation suite.

Job Responsibilities

• Perform manual and automated testing on existing and new applications, including internal origination, underwriting, and servicing systems as well as customer- and dealer-facing portals.

• Design, execute, and maintain test cases and automated test scripts to validate functionality across legacy and current platforms.

• Analyze test data and results to identify defects, isolate root cause, and document technical issues clearly for engineering teams.

• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to reproduce issues, clarify requirements, and validate fixes.

• Participate as an active member of an Agile Scrum team - sprint planning, backlog refinement, story review, and retrospectives - to build quality into the development process from the start.

• Develop and extend automated test coverage using a test automation framework.

• Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing techniques - including AI-generated test cases from requirements/user stories, self-healing test scripts, and intelligent test selection/prioritization - to expand automation coverage and cut maintenance overhead.

• Use AI-based tools to accelerate analysis of test results, logs, and failure patterns, surfacing likely root cause faster than manual triage alone.

• Track and manage defects through the team's bug-tracking system, providing clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact assessments.

• Support regression testing across releases affecting both internal tools and customer/dealer-facing applications.

• Identify bottlenecks in the QA process and swim lane, and recommend process, workflow, or tooling improvements to reduce backlog risk and manual dependency.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, quality assurance, or engineering emphasis or equivalent preferred

• 4-6 years of experience in software quality assurance, combining manual and automated testing.

• Experience testing web applications; comfort working across both legacy and modern platforms.

• Working knowledge of a test automation framework and scripting for automated tests.

• Strong aptitude and eagerness to adopt AI-assisted testing tools and techniques (e.g., AI-generated test cases, self-healing automation scripts, AI-driven test prioritization or log/anomaly analysis). This is an emerging space - a builder mindset and willingness to experiment matter more here than prior hands-on tenure with AI-specific tooling.

• Experience with a bug-tracking or test-management tool.

• Basic SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience working within Agile Scrum teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate root cause across multi-system workflows.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills for documenting defects and collaborating with a distributed team.

• Experience testing applications in financial services, lending, or equipment leasing is preferred.

• Exposure to API testing is preferred.

• Experience testing customer- or dealer-facing web portals is preferred.

Benefits

• Parental Insurance Coverage

• Accident Policy

• Retirement Benefits (Provident Fund)

description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry's SDKs instrument dozens of platforms and our ingest pipeline takes in billions of events every day. The Telemetry Experience team owns what happens next: the product surfaces and APIs where that telemetry turns into something a developer can actually debug with.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Telemetry Experience, you'll own that experience across the sentry.io http://sentry.io product - Python/Django and Postgres on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend. You'll work upstream with our SDK teams on what gets sent and with our ingest teams on how it arrives, then own the part customers actually touch: the APIs, the workflows, and the interfaces where it all lands. Your job is to make that feel native to every developer who uses it, whether they ship a backend service, a mobile app, or a game.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Own projects end to end. Take a problem from a rough customer complaint through scoping, design, implementation across the stack, rollout, and measurement. You'll write the design doc, cut the work into shippable pieces, and stay with it until the numbers move

- Work across the full stack of the Sentry monolith. React and TypeScript in the browser, Django and Postgres behind the API. Most projects here touch both, and the interesting decisions live at the seam

- Partner closely with SDK and ingest teams. Telemetry arrives exactly as the SDKs send it and as the pipeline shapes it. You'll shape those contracts together with the engineers who own them, rather than working around what shows up

- Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and other product engineers. You'll bring the technical perspective that makes a design better, explain constraints in terms of what they cost the user, and sweat the details other people skip: empty states, error messages, loading behavior, the edge case that only bites 2% of accounts

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- You'd rather own an outcome than a ticket. You take ambiguous problems, decide what to build, drive it across team boundaries, and follow through after launch. Nobody has to hand you a spec

- You're obsessed with making an experience smooth. Friction offends you. You notice the extra click, the confusing label, the query that takes 400ms too long - and you fix them instead of filing them

- You solve problems for customers, not for the codebase. Sentry's users are developers, so you can read their bug reports, sit in their tooling, and tell the difference between what they asked for and what they need

- You communicate well in writing. Working across SDK teams, ingest teams, product, and design in a distributed company means your docs, PR descriptions, and updates do a lot of the work

- You like being full-stack. You don't need a handoff to change an API and the component that calls it, and you enjoy holding the whole path from event payload to rendered pixel in your head

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional experience building and shipping full-stack web applications

- Strong experience with React and TypeScript, and with Python (Django or similar) backed by a relational database such as PostgreSQL - depth in one side and real competence in the other is fine

- A track record of driving non-trivial projects end to end, including the parts that require getting other teams to agree with you

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

- Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to enhance productivity and code quality

BONUS POINTS

- Familiarity with the application monitoring and observability space

- Experience building developer-facing pr

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you will work across the full stack to understand customer problems, rapidly prototype solutions, and build production-ready applications that deliver real value.

You will:

• Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with customers.

Nice to Have

• Background in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Aerospace, or another engineering discipline.

• Experience in a customer-facing, solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed role.

Working Conditions

• Full-time, 40h/week

• 1099 Contract initially

• PTO provided

• Background check required

Our values

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made up of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals who work together to bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team helps customers understand how highly capable AI can transform their businesses. As an Account Director, Large Enterprise, you’ll work with some of our largest accounts across a variety of industries, winning new business and expanding adoption within existing customers.

This role combines technical understanding, executive engagement, and ownership of complex enterprise sales. You’ll create demand, develop opportunities, and lead deals from initial engagement through negotiation, deployment, and expansion. You’ll help executives move from curiosity about AI to a clear understanding of how it can change the way their businesses operate-and build a practical path to realizing that value.

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy.

- Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements.

- Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha.

- Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator.

- Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing.

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote - we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Paris, and Tel Aviv.

Runway is hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to own how we find and stop attacks against our infrastructure, our research environment and our products.

Securing a company that trains and serves frontier video models is a different problem from securing a typical SaaS product. The environment includes research compute, large training datasets, a fast-moving build pipeline and engineers who work inside AI-assisted tooling every day. Each of those changes what an attack looks like and what you need to see to catch it.

You'll join the Security team and build our detection and response program the way an engineer would: detections as code, response as automation, evidence as something you can query. This is a role with real ownership: you'll own the detection program end to end, from what we log to how quickly we close an incident. Basic Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent work experience

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise Identity and Access Management, with a concentration in identity provisioning and directory services

• Hands-on production experience with Ping Directory (or PingDirectoryProxy), including replication and performance tuning

• Deep working knowledge of LDAP/LDAPS fundamentals: schema design, referrals, and replication conflict resolution

• Experience designing and building provisioning workflows and connectors (SCIM, JIT, custom connector development)

• Scripting experience in JavaScript, Python and PowerShell for automation, tooling, and provisioning

• Demonstrated ability to make and articulate architectural tradeoffs, and to set technical direction for other engineers

• Ability to work effectively in a remote-first team environment

Desired Characteristics

• Experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ or other IGA platforms, and collaborating with governance teams

• Experience with hybrid identity architectures (Azure AD/Entra ID) and multi-forest Active Directory environments

• Exposure to broader security architecture concepts: PAM boundaries, service account lifecycle, and privileged directory access

• Experience leading directory consolidation or large-scale migration projects

• Prior experience mentoring engineers or informally setting technical direction across a team

title: DevOps
description:
This position is within a project with one of the foundational LLM companies. The goal is to assist these foundational LLM companies in enhancing their Large Language Models.
One way we help these companies improve their models is by providing them with high-quality proprietary data. This data serves two main purposes: first, as a basis for fine-tuning their models, and second, as an evaluation set to benchmark the performance of their models or competitor models.
For example, for SFT data generation, you might have to put together or be provided a prompt which contains provided code and questions, you will then provide the model responses and write corresponding script to solve the questions. A collection of 5k-10k such samples could form the dataset for model fine-tuning.
For RLHF data generation, you might have to put together or be provided a prompt by the customer, ask the model questions, and evaluate the outputs generated by two versions of the LLM model. You'd compare these outputs and provide feedback, which is then used to fine-tune the models. Please note that this role does not require you to build LLMs or fine-tune them.
What does day-to-day look like:

• Design and develop challenging prompts based on provided source code with good coverage of DevOps and Infrastructure technologies

• Implement the verified code that can be executed to verify whether a model's response to the prompt is correct or not

• Conduct evaluations (Evals) to benchmark model performance and analyze results for continuous improvement.

• Evaluate and rank AI model responses to user queries across diverse domains, ensuring alignment with predefined criteria.

• Develop comprehensive explanations and rationales for evaluations, showcasing excellent reasoning and technical expertise.

• Lead efforts in Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), including creating and maintaining high-quality, task-specific datasets.

• Collaborate with researchers and annotators to execute Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) and refine reward models.

• Design innovative evaluation strategies and processes to improve the model's alignment with user needs and ethical guidelines.

• Create and refine optimal responses to improve AI performance, emphasizing clarity, relevance, and technical accuracy.

• Conduct thorough peer reviews of code and documentation, providing constructive feedback and identifying areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve model performance and contribute to product enhancements.

• Continuously explore and integrate new tools, techniques, and methodologies to enhance AI training processes.

• Requirements:

• Technical Expertise:

• Proven 5+ yrs of experience with configuration management and infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and/or similar platforms.

• Strong exposure to AWS cloud platforms with experience in designing and managing multi-cloud environments.

• Hands-on experience with container technologies (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

• Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Python, etc.) for automation and tool integration.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.) and version control systems (Git).

Operational Excellence:

• Experience setting up monitoring, logging, and alerting mechanisms to ensure system health and quick incident response.

• Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and high availability design in cloud infrastructures.

• Professional Skills:

• 5+ years of overall work experience in DevOps or related roles.

• Demonstrable ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts.

• Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving system bottlenecks and vulnerabilities.

• Fluent in conversational and written English communication.

* Work in a fully remote environment.

title: Account Manager

Hireframe is a remote staffing company that helps US-based startups and growth-stage companies build high-performing offshore teams. Our clients are founders, operators, and lean teams - not enterprise procurement departments. They move fast, change direction, and expect their partners to think alongside them. We operate like a startup ourselves: no bureaucracy, high ownership, and a constant bias toward action.
This is a full-cycle account management role. You will own a portfolio of 20+ active clients across a range of industries - and be responsible for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You are not a coordinator or a customer service rep. You are the person clients call when something matters, and you are expected to have an answer, a plan, or a path to one.
This role is designed for someone earlier in their career who has already proven they can own client relationships independently, and who wants to develop into a senior strategic AM over time. You will be coached, challenged, and given real ownership from day one but we expect you to come with strong fundamentals and a drive to grow into more.
What you'll own:

• A portfolio of 20+ active client accounts across the US - primarily startups, founder-led businesses, and growth-stage companies

• Monthly client syncs: setting the agenda, running the call, capturing action items, uncovering future needs, and following through

• Account health: proactively monitoring engagement, identifying risk signals before they become churn

• Expansion: recognizing when a client is ready to grow and initiating those conversations

• Coordination with the recruiting team on active placements - you are the client’s point of accountability

• Data hygiene: accurate, up-to-date account data, notes, and next steps at all times

• Escalation: knowing when a situation needs leadership, and escalating clearly and early vs. fully owning your accounts and making the best decisions for both the client and Hireframe

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in account management, client success, or a client-facing role with end-to-end ownership of client relationships.

• Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment, with the ability to thrive alongside founders, lean teams, and rapidly evolving processes.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the confidence to communicate effectively with US-based clients.

• Availability to work during US business hours and align schedules with client needs.

• Highly coachable and growth-oriented, with a willingness to ask questions, absorb feedback, and implement improvements quickly.

• Strong goal-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance, take ownership of retention and expansion metrics, and remain accountable for results.

• Demonstrated proactive communication skills, consistently providing updates and addressing issues before being prompted.

• Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to effectively manage a high volume of clients in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.

Nice to have:

• Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR, or professional services

• Prior exposure to US-based startup culture and expectations

• Experience managing or coordinating across offshore teams

Benefits
Hireframe provides nearshore and offshore staffing solutions, operating as a remote-first organization with team members located in the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. Our robust benefits package includes:

• Permanent remote work flexibility

• Paid Time Off

• Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) coverage

title: Director, Marketing Process & Technology
description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role Ethos is hiring a Director, Marketing Process & Technology to join our Compliance department as a senior leader. This person will own marketing compliance review at Ethos end to end: the process, the technology, and the majority of the reviews themselves. You will be both a hands-on senior reviewer and the owner of the system that performs the review, and you will be charged with a clear mandate: move marketing review toward automation through AI as far as it can defensibly go, without loosening the standard.
You will serve as business owner of the AI tool Ethos uses for marketing review, and you will be measured, in part, on how much of the review volume that tool can absorb and how reliably it performs. At the same time, you will personally handle the judgment calls, escalations, and novel questions that automation should not decide. Beyond the tool, you own the marketing review process itself: intake, prioritization, review standards, approved language, recordkeeping, and the working relationship with Marketing/Brand/business teams. This is a player-coach role. You will carry a real review load from day one and will eventually hire and oversee a compliance analyst to support you, which means building the standards, playbooks, and training that make the work delegable. You will be expected to drive thought leadership on marketing compliance matters across Ethos . Importantly, the candidate must be risk-minded, be a team player, confident in determining acceptable risk, think creatively to always find solutions, and be technology forward.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Own the AI marketing review tool and drive the shift toward automated, AI review, including:

•

• Act as business owner and administrator of the tool, including configuration, rule and prompt tuning, testing, and release management

• Define the automation tiers : what AI approves outright, what AI reviews subject to human confirmation, and what always requires human review

• Continuously improve automated review quality by measuring the tool’s output against human review, tuning to reduce missed issues, and expanding the categories of content it can handle

• Establish human-in-the-loop thresholds, sampling, and ongoing QA to validate that the tool remains reliable as content, products, and regulations change

• Own the auditability of AI-assisted decisions so that any approval can be reconstructed and defended to an examiner, auditor, or carrier

• Partner with vendors and with internal engineering and data teams on integration, evaluation, and roadmap

• Grow the share of reviews completed through automation as a primary, measured objective

Own the marketing compliance review process, including:

•

• Design and run intake for all marketing review requests, with clear SLAs, routing, and prioritization

• Maintain the review standards of record , including: review criteria, required disclosures, and the library of pre-approved claims and language

• Personally perform the majority of reviews and serve as decision-maker on close calls, documenting rationale so decisions accumulate into usable precedent

• Maintain the recordkeeping and audit trail of submissions, versions, approvals, and conditions of approval

• Measure and improve throughput, cycle time, and review quality

Cover the full range of marketing content subject
